description: Replace existing text content or edit its style. This can overwrite the selected wording. Resolve targets from session state. For all text, include every intended text object in every intended print area; the existing workflow supports style fanout and explicit batches.

options.description: Existing arguments; advanced fields/aliases remain accepted. Supplied design patches can overwrite session content; preview/rendering can fetch public image URLs in those designs. Catalogue/session results include the full designArgumentSchema.

fontFamily.description: Use a fontFamily returned in current designOptions.

placement.description: x/y are normalized centres. coordinateSpace=print_area uses garment print bounds; otherwise stage. width/height use stage unless dimensionSpace=print_area.

text.description: Text string or object: text, fontFamily, fontSize, fill, align, x, y, width, coordinateSpace.

requestId.description: Generate a UUID for a new action. Reuse it only for retrying/polling that same action and payload. A new user edit needs a new UUID.

sessionToken.description: The private expiring capability returned by start_design_session. Do not publish it.

subject.description: The exact subject returned by start_design_session.

name: update_text
title: Edit text
